description: Defines the WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase class and related enums and helper classes for handling WebSocket handshake streams in Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for WebSocket handshake streams, providing interface and enums for handshake result states.

classes.name: WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase::CreateHelper
classes.description: Helper class for creating WebSocket handshake streams for different protocols (HTTP/1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3).

methods.name: Upgrade
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketStream from the handshake stream after completion.

methods.name: CanReadFromStream
methods.description: Checks if reading from the stream will succeed.

methods.name: MultipleHeaderValuesMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for multiple header values.

methods.name: GetWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the WebSocketHandshakeStreamBase object.

methods.name: AddVectorHeaderIfNonEmpty
methods.description: Adds a header with multiple values if the vector is non-empty.

methods.name: ValidateSubProtocol
methods.description: Validates the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header against requested protocols.

methods.name: RecordHandshakeResult
methods.description: Records the result of the handshake attempt.
